title: OASIS EDXL-RM 1.0 Resource Messaging (BEACON full mutual-aid round-trip)
description: JSON representation of the OASIS Emergency Data Exchange Language Resource Messaging (EDXL-RM) 1.0 message set (urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:EDXL:RM:1.0). Models the full mutual-aid lifecycle round-trip: RequestResource -> CommitResource / ResponseToRequestResource, plus RequestResourceDeploymentStatus and its ResponseToRequestResourceDeploymentStatus. Each message wraps one or more ContentObject blocks that carry ResourceInformation. All messages in one round-trip share an OriginatingMessageID / correlation chain. This is a boundary serialization mapped to/from the canonical RESOURCE / RESOURCE_TASK / SHELTER entities by the EdxlPort anti-corruption adapter (ADR-001, ADR-010). ST1/UW5: no RM message is emitted from an UNVERIFIED report.

messageType.description: The EDXL-RM message type for this envelope. Determines its role in the round-trip.

messageID.description: EDXL-RM <MessageID> — globally unique id (URN) for THIS message.

sentDateTime.description: EDXL-RM <SentDateTime> — ISO 8601 date/time with timezone offset.

messageContentType.description: EDXL-RM <MessageContentType> — must equal the messageType (kept for spec fidelity).

messageDescription.description: EDXL-RM <MessageDescription> — free-text description of the message.

language.description: RFC 3066/BCP-47 language tag for the human-readable text in THIS message (messageDescription, incidentInformation[].incidentDescription, contentObject[].contentDescription, resource.name/description). NOT a native EDXL-RM 1.0 (OS + approved errata) element — the resource-messaging data dictionary defines no Language/LanguageCode/xml:lang construct (verified against the OASIS OS+errata spec text; RFC3066 is cited only as a normative reference, never wired to an element). This field borrows the name and RFC 3066 semantics of OASIS EDXL-DE 2.0's <language>/<contentLanguage> element (0..1, xsd:language) — the EDXL family's actual, standards-defined mechanism for tagging payload/content language — applied at the message level because BEACON emits bare RM JSON without an EDXL-DE transport wrapper (ADR-010 scopes RM+SitRep+CAP, not DE). Machine-readable fields (messageType/ID, resourceInfoElementID, resourceStatus, quantity, geometry) are NEVER a function of this field (FUW-2 doctrine, mirrored from CAP <language>).

originatingMessageID.description: EDXL-RM <OriginatingMessageID> — the MessageID of the message that initiated this round-trip (the RequestResource). This is the ROUND-TRIP CORRELATION ID: a request and every commit/response/status reply that answers it share the same originatingMessageID, enabling request->commit->response lifecycle assertions (ADR-010 round-trip fidelity tests).

precedingMessageID.description: EDXL-RM <PrecedingMessageID> — the MessageID this message is a direct reply to (e.g. a CommitResource cites the RequestResource it commits against). Forms the reply chain within a round-trip.

incidentInformation.description: EDXL-RM <IncidentInformation> — incident(s) the resource action relates to.

contentObject.description: EDXL-RM <ContentObject> — one or more content blocks, each carrying ResourceInformation. At least one required.
EDXL-RM <ContentObject> — a unit of content within an RM message.

contentDescription.description: EDXL-RM <ContentDescription> — description of this content object.

resourceInformation.description: EDXL-RM <ResourceInformation> — one or more resources described by this content object.
EDXL-RM <ResourceInformation> — describes a requested/committed/deployed resource plus its assignment, schedule and location.

resourceInfoElementID.description: EDXL-RM <ResourceInfoElementID> — id correlating a resource across request/commit/response (per-resource correlation inside a round-trip).

responseInformation.description: EDXL-RM <ResponseInformation> — present on reply messages (CommitResource / ResponseToRequestResource) indicating accept/decline/provisional for this resource.

resource.description: EDXL-RM <Resource> — the resource itself (type, name, status, owning org).

typeStructure.description: EDXL-RM <TypeStructure> — typed resource category (e.g. NIMS resource typing).

quantity.description: EDXL-RM <Quantity> — amount of the resource requested/committed.

assignmentInformation.description: EDXL-RM <AssignmentInformation> — cost, restrictions, ownership and price of the assignment.

scheduleInformation.description: EDXL-RM <ScheduleInformation> — requested/committed timing windows (report-to, arrival, etc.).

resourceID.description: EDXL-RM <ResourceID> — unique id of the physical/logical resource (maps to canonical RESOURCE.id).

typeStructure.description: EDXL-RM resource type structure (e.g. CREW|ENGINE|AIRCRAFT|MEDICAL|SUPPLY mapped to a typing scheme).

ownershipInformation.description: EDXL-RM <OwnershipInformation> — owning organisation of the resource.

resourceStatus.description: EDXL-RM <ResourceStatus> — used heavily by RequestResourceDeploymentStatus / its response.

availability.description: EDXL-RM <Availability> — current availability of the resource.

deploymentStatus.description: Deployment lifecycle state (maps to canonical RESOURCE_TASK status PROPOSED|TASKED|ENROUTE|ONSCENE|CLEARED).

responseInformation.description: EDXL-RM <ResponseInformation> — disposition of a request for a given resource.

precedingResourceInfoElementID.description: EDXL-RM <PrecedingResourceInfoElementID> — the ResourceInfoElementID from the request being answered (per-resource round-trip link).

measuredQuantity.description: EDXL-RM <Quantity> as a MeasuredQuantity (amount + unit of measure).

scheduleInformation.description: EDXL-RM <ScheduleInformation> — a timing element with type, time(s) and location.

scheduleType.description: EDXL-RM <ScheduleType> — the kind of schedule entry.

dateTime.description: EDXL-RM <DateTime> — point-in-time for this schedule entry.

location.description: EDXL-RM <Location> — where this schedule entry applies (report-to / arrival point).
EDXL-RM <Location> — geo-location of a resource/schedule element. GeoJSON used for geometry per ADR-010.

targetArea.description: Geometry as GeoJSON (RFC 7946) — Point/Polygon etc. per ADR-010 GeoJSON/OGC decision.

coordinates.description: Coordinate array; structure depends on geometry type (lon,lat order per RFC 7946).

incidentID.description: Incident id (GLIDE id per ADR-010, maps to canonical INCIDENT.id).

valueListUrn.description: EDXL ValueList/Value pair (a controlled-vocabulary code with its scheme URN).

allOf.description: Reply-type messages must declare the request they answer (round-trip integrity).
